transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what’s been going on that brought you in today?

I came in because my family made me, honestly. They keep showing me these bank papers and telling me they prove nothing was taken from my accounts. But... I mean, for over a year now, I’ve known for a fact that they’re hiding my money. They use all these things to cover it up—like paying bills, setting up fundraisers, talking about planning trips. It’s all just a way to move my money around behind my back. I just... I have to keep confronting them about it until they finally tell the truth.
Can you tell me more about how you know your family is hiding your money? Have you had these concerns for some time?

Well, it started right around the time my income dropped. That was about a year and two months ago. That's how long this has been going on. Ever since then, I just... I know the money isn't adding up, no matter what those papers they show me say.
Do you believe your family has been deliberately deceiving you about your finances, even though there's no evidence to support this?

Yes, I do. Like I was just saying, my family—and my friends are in on it too—they keep telling me those bank papers prove nothing was taken. But I know they are hiding my money. 

They just use all that normal stuff to cover their tracks. The bills, the fundraisers, the trip plans... it's all just a trick to move my money around. So, yes, they are definitely deceiving me, no matter what those papers say. And I have to keep confronting them about it. I'm not going to stop until they finally tell the truth.
Have you experienced any other situations where you felt people were plotting against you or that things in your life were being controlled in a way that others don't seem to notice?

No, I haven't noticed anything like that. It's just the money. I don't think people are plotting against me in other ways or... or controlling my life. I just know what they're doing with my accounts, that's all. It's really just about the money.
Have you ever had thoughts that someone was trying to harm you, or that you had special powers or abilities, or that messages were being sent to you through everyday things?

No, I don't have any of that. Nobody's trying to hurt me or anything. And I definitely don't have any special powers... I'm just a normal person. I don't get messages from things either. Like I said, it's just my family and friends hiding my money. That's the only thing going on.
